principle: Every proprietary score exposes its component inputs and weights. Scores support prioritization; they are not legal, appraisal, credit, investment or transaction outcomes.

watchdog.investor_carry_cost_volatility.range: 0-100; higher means more tax-driven carry uncertainty
watchdog.investor_carry_cost_volatility.formula: 32% municipal budget pressure + 24% positive levy/ratable growth gap + 22% revaluation pressure + 14% positive tax-rate CAGR + 8% exempt/PILOT exposure

watchdog.appeal_evidence_strength.range: 0-100; higher means a stronger evidence file
watchdog.appeal_evidence_strength.formula: 25% independent value anchor + 20% Chapter 123 margin + 18% verified comparable depth + 14% assessment-uniformity context + 10% county outcome context + 13% property-record completeness

watchdog.permit_lifecycle_score.range: 0-100; higher means more permit lifecycle review
watchdog.permit_lifecycle_score.formula: Up to 45 points stale open permits + 25 open permit/certificate gaps + 20 oldest-open age + 10 recent permit frequency

watchdog.listing_friction_index.formula: 23% budget pressure + 23% revaluation pressure + 18% assessment unevenness + 18% tax-rate trend + 18% appeal/assessment tension

watchdog.tax_carry_advantage.formula: Inverse normalized effective property-tax burden using current tax divided by independent market-value estimate

watchdog.buyer_objection_radar.formula: Maximum current budget, revaluation, assessment-uniformity or appeal-tension signal

watchdog.prelist_readiness_score.formula: 55% record completeness + 25% verified-sale evidence depth + 20% inverse listing friction

watchdog.marketability_drag_index.formula: 34% effective tax burden + 23% budget pressure + 23% revaluation pressure + 20% assessment unevenness

watchdog.offer_diligence_priority.formula: 55% listing friction + 25% missing property-record evidence + 20% missing verified-sale evidence depth

watchdog.verified_listing_story_strength.formula: 50% record completeness + 35% verified-sale evidence depth + 15% assessment consistency

watchdog.assessment_surprise_index.formula: 40% revaluation pressure + 30% appeal/assessment tension + 15% tax-rate trend + 15% budget pressure

watchdog.tax_trend_position.formula: Inverse normalized positive historical general-tax-rate CAGR
